mapper.select:
WITH MinDiscountedRooms AS ( SELECT r.accommodation_no, MIN(ROUND(r.room_price * (1 - (r.room_discount / 100)))) AS min_discounted_price FROM room r GROUP BY r.accommodation_no )
SELECT a.accommodation_no as accommodationNo, a.accommodation_name as accommodationName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.accommodation_address,' ',2) as accommodationAddress, a.accommodation_address as accommodationFullAddress, r.room_price AS roomPrice, r.room_discount AS roomDiscount, ROUND(r.room_price * (1 - (r.room_discount / 100))) AS discountedPrice, i.filename as filename FROM likes l JOIN member m ON l.member_no = m.member_no JOIN accommodation a ON l.accommodation_no = a.accommodation_no JOIN MinDiscountedRooms mdr ON a.accommodation_no = mdr.accommodation_no JOIN room r ON a.accommodation_no = r.accommodation_no AND ROUND(r.room_price * (1 - (r.room_discount / 100))) = mdr.min_discounted_price JOIN room_image i ON a.accommodation_no = i.accommodation_no WHERE l.member_no = #{memberNo};
mapper.delete: delete from likes where accommodation_no = #{accommodationNo} and member_no = #{memberNo}
mapper.select: select EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM likes WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} and accommodation_no = #{accommodationNo})
